kurz: Baking soda baked in the oven becomes washing soda, a stronger base. With it, pretzels turn almost as brown as with real lye, without its danger.
bild_im_kopf: Like coffee getting stronger as it roasts: the same bean, but one step stronger.
sicherheit: Washing soda irritates skin and eyes: wear gloves, keep it away from your face and out of children's reach.
ergebnis: Around 130 g of washing soda from 200 g of baking soda, because weight is lost as water and carbon dioxide during baking (as a guide).
material: baking tray lined with baking paper (no aluminium)
verwendung: Pretzels, lye rolls, lye-dipped braided bread.
A pinch in the cooking water for Chinese noodles with bite.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Spread the baking soda on the tray and bake for 2 hours at 120 °C
schluesselmomente.warum: Heat drives off water and carbon dioxide. Baking soda becomes washing soda (sodium carbonate), and the base gets stronger: [[ph-wert|pH about]] 11 instead of 8.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Let it cool, put it into a jar while dry and label it
schluesselmomente.warum: Washing soda looks like baking soda but is more irritating. That is why you label it.

schluesselmomente.schritt: For dipping, dissolve about 150 g in just under 500 ml of warm water
schluesselmomente.warum: The bath has to be strong so that the surface takes up enough base (amount from America’s Test Kitchen).

schluesselmomente.schritt: Dip the pretzels briefly, rinse, salt and bake hot
schluesselmomente.warum: The alkaline surface browns quickly and shines.
